description: HP-16 RTO serves the Rajgarh subdivision in the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. It functions as a Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) responsible for issuing driving licenses, vehicle registrations, and fitness certificates. Rajgarh is a vital administrative center known as the Peach Valley, and this office handles transport services for its hilly terrain.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Rajgarh, District Sirmaur, Himachal Pradesh
